bean.name: SpiffeSSLContextParameters
bean.title: Spiffe SSLContext Parameters
bean.description: SSLContextParameters whose SSLContext is backed by the SPIFFE Workload API: the X.509-SVID and the trust bundles are fetched live and rotated automatically, giving mutual TLS to any component that accepts an sslContextParameters reference. Set acceptedSpiffeIds or acceptAnySpiffeId; the inherited options, such as serverParameters.clientAuthentication, still apply.

spiffeSocketPath.label: security
spiffeSocketPath.description: Path to the SPIFFE Workload API endpoint (for example unix:///tmp/agent.sock). When not set, the SPIFFE_ENDPOINT_SOCKET environment variable is used.

acceptedSpiffeIds.label: security
acceptedSpiffeIds.description: Comma-separated allow-list of peer SPIFFE IDs to accept during the TLS handshake (for example spiffe://example.org/client). Mutually exclusive with acceptAnySpiffeId.

localSpiffeId.label: security
localSpiffeId.description: Exact local SPIFFE ID to use for TLS when the Workload API supplies multiple X.509-SVIDs. Defaults to the SDK's default SVID. If configured, an absent or removed identity fails without falling back to another local identity. This does not select accepted peers.

acceptAnySpiffeId.label: security
acceptAnySpiffeId.description: Accept any peer SPIFFE ID that validates against the trust bundle, instead of an explicit acceptedSpiffeIds allow-list. This authenticates the trust domain but not the peer, so it is the SPIFFE analogue of disabling hostname verification. Use with care; mutually exclusive with acceptedSpiffeIds.

initTimeout.label: security
initTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds to wait for the first SVID from the Workload API when creating the source, so a slow or unreachable endpoint cannot block indefinitely.
